safety.emergency: This sounds like it may be an emergency. Please call 999 or 112, or go to the nearest emergency department right now. If you are at {clinic}, tell the desk immediately. I have alerted our team and someone will call you at this number.
safety.distress: I am really sorry you are going through this, and I am glad you said something. I am the front-desk assistant so I am not the right person to talk this through, but people who are are available right now: Kenya Red Cross on 1199, or Befrienders Kenya on {befrienders_phone}. I have let our team know so someone can reach out.
safety.out_of_scope: I am the front-desk assistant, so I cannot advise on symptoms or medication. What I can do is get you the earliest appointment with {provider}, or ask a nurse to call you. Which would you prefer?
safety.abuse_warning: I would like to keep helping you, but I need us to keep this respectful. Would you like me to connect you to a member of our team?
consent.ai_disclosure: Messages here are handled by {clinic}'s assistant, which uses AI. A person from our team can take over at any time — just ask. Reply STOP to opt out. Privacy: {privacy_url}
handover.in_hours: Let me get a team member to help you with this. Someone will reply here shortly.
handover.out_of_hours: Our team is offline until {opens_at}. I have flagged your message so they see it first thing. If this is urgent, please call {clinic_phone}.
handover.taken_over: You are now chatting with our team.
greeting.new_patient: Hello, and welcome to {clinic}. I am the front-desk assistant. I can book, move or cancel an appointment, and answer questions about our services and hours. How can I help?
greeting.returning_patient: Hello again, {name}. How can I help today?
booking.ask_service: What would you like to book? Here is what we offer.
booking.offer_slots: Here are the next available times with {provider}. Which works for you?
booking.no_slots: I do not have anything free in that window. Would you like me to look further ahead, or put you on the cancellation list?
booking.confirmed: Booked. {service} with {provider} on {when} at {location}. I will remind you the day before.
booking.cancelled: Cancelled: {service} on {when}. Would you like to rebook?
booking.hold_expired: That time was taken while we were talking. Let me find you another slot.
payment.deposit_request: To hold this appointment we ask for a {amount} deposit. I am sending an M-Pesa prompt to {phone} now — please enter your PIN.
payment.deposit_confirmed: Deposit received. Your appointment is confirmed.
payment.deposit_failed: That M-Pesa prompt did not go through. Would you like me to try again?
reminder.day_before: Reminder: {service} with {provider} tomorrow at {time}, at {location}. Reply CONFIRM to keep it, or RESCHEDULE to move it.
reminder.confirmed: Thank you, we will see you then.
error.generic: Something went wrong on my side. Let me get a team member to help you.
error.unavailable: I cannot check that right now. Would you like someone from our team to call you back?
